games.title: Arena Shooter
games.tag: online multiplayer · first person · up to 8
games.desc: First-person drop-in deathmatch in a generated arena. WASD + mouse look, Space jump, RMB zoom, R reload, Shift sprint, C crouch — crouching also shrinks your hitbox. Q raises an off-hand shield that doesn't just block a bullet, it reflects it back at the shooter. Jump onto the low crates and fight from up there; the tall containers stay hard cover. Grab glowing pads to upgrade your pistol. Textured basalt arena, an animated SWAT operator, Blender-built viewmodel with hands.

games.title: Fire Racer
games.desc: 8-player car racing around a circular track. WASD to drive, mouse to look (for player 1), click to accelerate. First to complete laps wins! Each car has unique controls on their own keyboard.

games.title: Pong Classic
games.desc: The first ember game. A/D vs arrow keys, first to 7.
